name: Namiko Li, Half-Oni Wu Jen

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Corrupting Serenity
traits.details: At the start of her turn, Namiko can make a saving throw against one effect that a save can end. If she saves, the effect ends on Namiko, and she can transfer it to an enemy adjacent to her. If her saving throw fails, Namiko can still make a saving throw against the effect at the end of her turn.

effect.description: Namiko can slide the target 1 square.

hit.description: 3d6 + 7 necrotic and psychic damage, and the target can’t see more than 2 squares away from itself (save ends).

Namiko chooses one of her allies within 10 squares of her (the ally cannot be an elite or a solo). The target is weakened when attacking any enemy other than the chosen ally. This effect lasts until the end of the encounter or until the chosen ally drops to 0 hit points.

powers.name: Deep Shadow
powers.description: The zone persists until the end of Namiko’s next turn, and Namiko can move the zone up to 4 squares.

effect.description: Area burst 1 within 10. The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of Namiko’s next turn. The zone is difficult terrain for her enemies. Any enemy that enters the zone or ends its turn there takes 10 necrotic damage.

Description.text: The zone persists until the end of Namiko’s next turn, and Namiko can move the zone up to 4 squares.

effect.description: Namiko teleports up to 3 squares and becomes insubstantial until the start of her next turn.

powers.name: Shadow Augury
powers.trigger: An attack hits Namiko while she is bloodied.

effect.description: Shadow shield recharges, and Namiko uses it.
